reviewNotes: Reviewed all 80 source pairs, random seed/legacy semantics, multiplayer permissions, island restoration and forging terminology. Building chat article argument uses aOrAn plus building name in CarpenterMenu; Lexicon returns empty article in custom locales, so place it directly next to the unchanged building-name placeholder. HouseUpgrade uses the possessive argument after locuința; Lexicon must provide lui/ei. Controller star and beach separator preserved. Exact enchantment glossary noun vrajă applied.

AGO_FarmMonsters_Tooltip.source: Allows monsters to spawn at night.

AGO_ProfitMargin_Tooltip.source: A multiplier applied to the price of items sold.
AGO_ProfitMargin_Tooltip.translation: Un multiplicator aplicat prețului obiectelor vândute.

AGO_CabinLayout_Tooltip.source: Whether the cabins are placed closer or further away from one another.
AGO_CabinLayout_Tooltip.translation: Stabilește dacă sunt amplasate cabanele mai aproape sau mai departe unele de altele.

AGO_RandomSeed_Tooltip.source: The seed used to randomize the game world.
AGO_RandomSeed_Tooltip.translation: Valoarea folosită pentru generarea aleatorie a lumii jocului.

AGO_LegacyRandomization_Tooltip.source: Make random choices in a way that often repeats patterns. Most players should keep this disabled.
AGO_LegacyRandomization_Tooltip.translation: Face alegeri aleatorii într-un mod care repetă frecvent anumite tipare. Majoritatea jucătorilor ar trebui să lase această opțiune dezactivată.
